text: Installation within the framework of the seminar Apertus 02: Reflection at Escola Massana, taught by Sojung Jun in collaboration with the Han Nefkens Foundation.
An industrial after-life is an installation built around the concept of reflection. Reflection is understood as a mirror image, a mirror to another universe that is familiar yet strange.

A classroom is intervened and visitors are offered a route. By modifying and composing with the objects already there, a new space is generated. A level-0 escape room is designed, staging the waiting room of a dystopian airport, with looping elevator music. There are only two rules: you may not speak, nor leave the way you came in.
